Question: Ashley, Betty, Carlos, Dick, and Elgin went shopping. Each had a whole number of dollars to spend, and together they had \(\$56.\) The absolute difference between the amounts Ashley and Betty had to spend was \(\$19.\) The absolute difference between the amounts Betty and Carlos had was \(\$7,\) between Carlos and Dick was \(\$5,\) between Dick and Elgin was \(\$4,\) and between Elgin and Ashley was \(\$11.\) How much did Elgin have?
